paragraphs.text: Last week, a small dinosaur came to Dino Valley. His name was Pip. He was the smallest dinosaur there. Pip had no friends because he was new.
paragraphs.translation: 上周，一只小恐龙来到了恐龙谷。他叫皮普。他是那里最小的恐龙。皮普没有朋友，因为他是新来的。

paragraphs.text: The big dinosaurs played near the tallest tree. They were too busy to see little Pip. Pip felt sad because nobody played with him.
paragraphs.translation: 大恐龙们在最高的那棵树旁玩耍。他们太忙了，没有看见小皮普。皮普很难过，因为没有人跟他玩。

paragraphs.text: Then a baby dinosaur got lost in the valley. He cried and looked for his mother. Pip ran to help him at once.
paragraphs.translation: 这时，一只恐龙宝宝在谷里迷了路。他哭着找妈妈。皮普立刻跑去帮忙。

paragraphs.text: Pip took the baby to the biggest hill. From there, they saw the baby's home. His mother ran to him and said thank you.
paragraphs.translation: 皮普把宝宝带到了最大的那座小山上。从那里，他们看见了宝宝的家。他的妈妈跑过来，说了声谢谢。

paragraphs.text: "You are the kindest dinosaur in Dino Valley," she said. All the big dinosaurs came to Pip. They smiled and said, "Welcome, little friend!"
paragraphs.translation: “你是恐龙谷里最善良的恐龙。”她说。所有的大恐龙都来到皮普身边。他们笑着说：“欢迎你，小朋友！”

paragraphs.text: Pip was happy because he had many friends now. He was the smallest, but also the kindest. Dino Valley was the best home for him.
paragraphs.translation: 皮普很开心，因为现在他有很多朋友了。他是最小的，但也是最善良的。恐龙谷是他最好的家。
